{{Quote|Station to all units. Explosion at Dweed-Kor's Pawn Shop. Officer in charge is Insepctor Fey'lya.|[[Escra Fey'lya]]'s OPS radio|<ref name="Challenge">{{LivingForce|Polarization: Challenge}}</ref>}}
'''Dweed-Kor's Pawn Shop''' was a shop that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], there was an explosion inside the shop, and the [[Office of Peace and Security]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Escra Fey'lya]] was sent to investigate it.
